text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
As Yui makes her way back to Landosol after shopping in a nearby town,
she notices someone sleeping in the shade of a tree.
text_block_list.orig_text:
近くの街で買い物を終えたユイがランドソルへの
帰路を進んでいると、木陰で眠っている人物を見つけた──

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Is that... Mr. Knight?
It's pretty dangerous to be napping in a place like this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれは……
騎士クン？
こんなところでお昼寝なんて、
危ないなぁ……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
There's a light shining from Mr. Knight...!
Isn't that the strange light from a while back?
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クンから、
光が……！？
この光、
たしか前にも……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
It's too bright...!
Mr. Knight...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
眩しすぎる……！
騎士クン……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: ...Good morning, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……おはよう。
{0}くん。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Me? I came to get something I forgot.
You seemed like you were having a nice nap,
so I stayed quiet so as not to wake you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたし？　
忘れ物をとりにきたんだけど、
{0}くんがすごく気持ちよさそうに寝てたから、
起こしちゃダメだと思って静かにしてたの。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
...I can't tell him that I was watching his sleeping face
and lost track of time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……寝顔を見てたらこんな時間になっちゃった、
なんて言えないよね。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if he'll go home now too.
...I hope we can walk together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんも今から帰るのかな？
……一緒に帰りたいな。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: ...This classroom after school is straight out of a dream, don't you think?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……放課後の教室って、
まるで夢の中みたいだよね。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
...If this really is a dream, then maybe
I can tell him how I feel...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……本当に夢の中なら、{0}くんに
気持ちを伝えてみても……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Umm... Can we go home together?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの……
一緒に帰ってもいい？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Thank you...!
text_block_list.orig_text: ありがとう……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
A chance like this sure is rare...
Can I really tell him how I feel...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなチャンス、
滅多にないよ……
伝えられるかな
わたしの気持ち……？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks for walking home with me today.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……今日は一緒に帰ってくれてありがとう。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: ...By the way, the offline meetup the other day was real fun, wasn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そういえばこの間のオフ会、
楽しかったね。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: ...Oh yeah! Yesterday, Makoto...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そうだ！　
実は昨日真琴ちゃんが……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
The more we walk, the more my will to tell him what's in my heart
escapes me...
What should I do...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
歩いた分だけ、
心の奥に言いたいことが逃げていっちゃう……
どうしよう……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: At this rate...
text_block_list.orig_text: このままじゃ……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
This is where we... part ways.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ……
分かれ道に……
着いちゃった。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
...My house is this way.
...Thank you for walking home with me today.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……わたしの家、
こっちなんだ。
……今日は、
一緒に帰ってくれて……
ありがとう。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: ...I guess I'll see you tomorrow...
choice_data_list: I wanna hear what you've got to say.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……それじゃあ、
また明日……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: What I've got to say...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたしの、
話……？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
{0}... So you realized there was something
I wanted to tell you, but couldn't...
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん……
わたしが、
本当に伝えたいことを
話せなかったの、
分かってたんだ……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
...I understand, you know.
...That you being so kind to me doesn't mean anything special.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……わたしも分かってるよ。
……こうして優しくしてくれるのが、
特別じゃないってこと。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
But it doesn't matter if it's nothing special. At least, that's what I keep
telling myself... I just don't want you to hate me, so I keep my feelings
inside... Because maybe one day, these feelings will fade away...
text_block_list.orig_text:
特別じゃなくていいって、
何度も思った……
嫌われたくないから、
この気持ちを伝えなくていいって……
いつか
消えてなくなるかも知れないから……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: ...Even though I know they won't.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あなたを思う気持ちが、
消えるはずないのに。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, I always 
want to be with you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……わたしね。
本当はいつも、
{0}くんと一緒にいたいんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Not just on the way home, but actually by your side, forever...
And... I want you to be by my side...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
帰り道だけじゃなくて、
ずっとあなたのそばにいたい……
あなたに……
わたしのそばに、
いて欲しいの……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: ...What I'm saying is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
つまり、
あの……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: I really... like... you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あなたのことが……
好き……
です……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
...S-sorry! Suddenly spewing my feelings all over you
is a bit annoying, right...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ご、
ごめんね！　
いきなりこんな話されても、
迷惑だよね……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: ...G-goodbye!
choice_data_list: I'll always be by your side.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
さ、
さよならっ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
{0}...!
Really...? Are you sure? It's me we're talking about...
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん……！
いいの……？　
わたしなんかで……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ありがとう。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
...You know, it's not that far, so would you mind seeing me to my
house...? I want to spend more time talking to you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あのね。
近くなんだけど、
家まで送って欲しいなって……
もう少しだけ、
一緒にお話ししたいから……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: How was today's dream? I saw some interesting things. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日の夢はどうだった？　
あたしは面白いものが見れたわ♪

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
Yui made a bold move, didn't she? You too, of course.
Who'd have thought you'd say such a thing...?!
You'd better take full responsibility!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしてもユイってば大胆よね。
もちろんあんたもね。
まさかあんなことを言っちゃうなんて……！
あんた、
ちゃんと責任取りなさいよ？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Until next time. ♪ I wish you two happiness. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあね～♪　
お幸せに～♪

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
...Urghhh. ...It was just a dream,
but I confessed to Mr. Knight...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うぅぅ
……夢の中だけど、
騎士クンにあんなこと言っちゃった……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Knight!
G-good morning...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン！
お、
おはよう……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: I was wondering if... you'd like to go grocery shopping together...
text_block_list.orig_text:
食材の買い出し……
なら
一緒について行っちゃおうかな……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Knight... I had a dream.
I was with you in a classroom... with a view of the setting sun....
Do you by chance remember it...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン
……
夢を見たんだ。
夕日が見える学校の教室で……
騎士クンと一緒にいたんだけど……
もしかして、
覚えてる……？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: ...Of course you don't. Sorry for asking such an odd question.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そうだよね。
変なこと聞いて、
ごめんね……？

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: Yeah...
choice_data_list: It feels like I made some kind of important promise...
text_block_list.orig_text: うん……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
...Don't worry about it.
...Thanks for trying to remember.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……もう大丈夫。
……思い出そうとしてくれてありがとう。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: I guess it was all just a dream after all...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれはやっぱり、
夢の中の出来事なんだ……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: So only in a dream can I actually tell him how I feel...
text_block_list.orig_text:
夢の中でなら、
ちゃんと言えたのにな……

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: ...No. Thinking like that will get me nowhere!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
違う。
こんな考え方じゃダメだよ！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
I was able to say it in my dream, so one day I want to be able to say
the same thing in real life as well!
text_block_list.orig_text:
夢の中で言えたんだもん。
いつか現実でも
同じ言葉を、
言えるようになりたい……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
You know, Mr. Knight...
I actually have one more wish.
choice_data_list: I'll do what I can to help fulfill that wish.
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン。
わたしね……？
もう一つ、
叶えたい願いがあるの。

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Knight...!
Thank you... I'm going to try hard!
Someday, I'll make my wish come true!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士クン……！
ありがとう……
わたし、
これからも頑張るね！
いつかこの願いを、
叶えるために！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Because of the dream she shared with {0},
Yui developed a new wish, which she decided she
would pursue until its realization.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──{0}と見た夢をきっかけに
新たな願いを得たユイは、それを叶えるべく
努力を続けていこうと思った。
